caption: A spatial cross-section of a released cloud outside a spherical mass. Gold arrows show acceleration relative to the freely falling centre; blue dots show an exaggerated short-time deformation. The common inward fall is absent from this comoving picture.
alt: Two views of a small particle cloud. Initially circular with zero relative velocity, it later stretches radially and squeezes transversely. Gold arrows on the initial cloud show relative acceleration.

caption: The green route A–N–B–A bounds a spherical octant. Blue arrows follow parallel transport; at A the returned arrow is gold. The inset compares the start and return in A’s tangent plane: their true angle is 90°, although the sphere’s perspective view skews drawn angles. Arrow lengths in the perspective drawing are schematic.
alt: A sphere with a triangular route from equatorial A to the north pole N, down to equatorial B and back to A. Blue arrows are transported along the legs. At A a gold returned arrow is perpendicular to the initial one, shown without perspective in a tangent-plane inset.
